protocol.productionJs: esbuild minify of monaco-editor ESM + workers, then lilscript-codec gzip-9 / brotli-11
protocol.productionLil: lilscript compile of entry.lil runtime + 992 monaco-editor-core catalog modules (js-module keepers retain exported class methods), tree-shaken js-host once, workbench, esbuild minify, lilscript-codec
protocol.moduleJs: listed monaco-editor-core files only; other monaco imports external; esbuild minify; lilscript-codec
protocol.moduleLil: independently compiled catalog .lil with js-module keepers (exported class methods retained); js-host left external per file; lilscript-codec
protocol.moduleJsMinifiers: esbuild and terser; best Brotli wins

plugged: entire LilScript editor (entry.lil) plus monaco-editor-core catalog pack — no monaco-editor JS

pairs.title: Position
pairs.note: Single file. Lil class is Pos; monaco statics (equals, lift) are not a plug facade yet.

pairs.title: Range
pairs.note: JS keeps Position as an import. Lil inlines Pos.

pairs.title: Selection
pairs.note: monaco Selection extends Range. Lil Sel does not; not plugged.

pairs.title: Position + Range + Selection
pairs.note: The three files monaco actually ships. One Lil compile of the same three.

pairs.title: PieceTreeBase + rbTreeBase
pairs.note: Fair pair is pieceTreeBase + rbTreeBase. Buffer and builder are separate Lil files under vs/editor/common/model/pieceTreeTextBuffer/. findMatchesLineByLine is in Lil PieceTreeBase.

pairs.title: PieceTreeTextBuffer + Builder
pairs.note: Lil sources exist. Not scored here because the Lil compile of the wrapper also contains PieceTreeBase, while the JS side leaves pieceTreeBase external.

pairs.title: URI
pairs.note: Lil URI is the parse/file/inmemory subset, not win32/posix vscode URI.

pairs.title: Disposable + Emitter
pairs.note: Two monaco files. Emitter lives in event.js. Not the full vscode event service.

pairs.title: Decoration interval tree
pairs.note: Ported algorithm. Lil Decoration.metadata is the unpacked equivalent of monaco's packed node metadata bitfields.

pairs.title: Myers diff
pairs.note: Algorithm file only. monaco's defaultLinesDiffComputer graph is not in this pair.

pairs.title: Monarch compile
pairs.note: Compile file. monarchLexer.js is Lil in editor/monarch-lexer.lil.

pairs.title: Text model search
pairs.note: Ported. findMatchesLineByLine lives on Lil PieceTreeBase; Searcher is in search.lil.

pairs.title: Undo stack
pairs.note: Ported. TextModel uses the Lil edit stack.

protocol.js: each monaco-editor-core ESM file; other monaco imports external; esbuild minify; lilscript-codec gzip-9 / brotli-11
protocol.lil: independently compiled .lil implementations with js-module keepers so exported class methods stay in the artifact (source export class is type-only and would otherwise DCE to empty)
